section.hero.title: I build digital products that feel fast
section.hero.paragraph_1: I build web applications with a focus on performance, accessibility, and a codebase another team can maintain without fear.
section.hero.paragraph_2: I work with product teams from the first mockup to deployment, using React, Next.js and Postgres.

section.skills.paragraph: I choose tools by criteria and stability, not by hype. Every piece has to justify its maintenance cost.

section.aboutme.paragraph_1: I started coding out of curiosity and today I design whole systems: from the data model to the interface. I like products that explain themselves.
section.aboutme.paragraph_2: When I am not writing code, I prepare documentation and mentor people taking their first steps.

section.projects.title_lg: Things I built that are still alive
section.projects.paragraph: Every project summarizes a real need, a technical decision and what I learned along the way.

section.contact.paragraph: Tell me what you want to build and I reply with a concrete proposal, no runaround.

section.footer.built_with: Built with Next.js, TypeScript and Motion
